jobs.occupation: Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, Power Electronics (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: What to ExpectPlease not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. To breathe dynamic life into our static infrastructure data, we integrate global earth observation data into our central inference engine. In this role, you will add the dimension of real-time surface activity and physical states to our spatial intelligence models.
